quote: Shadows only grow when the sun goes down. You walk alone through a quiet street. Every corner hides a ghost of yesterday. The silence becomes too heavy to bear. You search for comfort in empty rooms. The dark remembers what your mind tries to forget. Peace is found when you finally turn on the light.
caption:
Shadows only grow when the sun goes down. You walk alone through a quiet street. Every corner hides a ghost of yesterday. The silence becomes too heavy to bear. You search for comfort in empty rooms. The dark remembers what your mind tries to forget. Peace is found when you finally turn on the light.
